explication: Agent2API is a local multi-provider AI gateway packaged with a Tauri desktop application. An OpenAI-compatible client sends chat requests to the local HTTP server; the gateway resolves the requested model, selects eligible accounts in global priority order, adapts and forwards requests to provider services, and returns the response. The desktop UI manages accounts, models, keys, settings, tasks, and reports. The README documents the end-to-end behavior; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX clarify pipeline, catalog, persistence, and scheduled-task responsibilities. Unsampled implementation details are represented only where documented.
